title: Agent Invocation Queued Event
description: The Hermes gateway durably claimed an agent command and it now waits for a conversation lock and an execution slot. Published once per accepted command, at claim and before the wait; every queued fact closes with exactly one invocation.completed or invocation.failed, and invocation.started is optional in between. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

context.description: Echo of the originating bloodbank.agent.invocation.start or .invoke command's data.context, verbatim. Ticket turns carry reason (ticket-grooming|ticket-delegation), repo, ticket_key, ticket_id, board_id, workspace, title and phase, so a consumer can tell what is pending for a ticket without knowing who sent the command. Omitted when the command carried no context.

lane.description: Delivery lane of the originating command: batch, interactive, or the opt-in BB-67 review feedback durable. Absent on facts written before the interactive lane existed.

issuer.description: The command envelope's actor, verbatim (who asked for the turn).

command_service.description: The command envelope's service (the sender, for example krebs-tick or n8n-ticket-grooming).

lane_inflight.description: Turns running on the command's lane at claim time (capacity diagnostic).

lane_queued.description: Commands claimed and waiting for a slot on the command's lane at claim time, including this one (capacity diagnostic).
